text: Marco De Rossi and Stefano Lavazza are the founders and owners of SC-Project.
short: SC-Project is owned by its founders, Marco De Rossi and Stefano Lavazza.

source.name: Wide Magazine (Piaggio Group): Aprilia Racing and SC-Project still together for the 2026 MotoGP season
source.quote: MARCO DE ROSSI AND STEFANO LAVAZZA, FOUNDERS AND OWNERS OF SC-PROJECT
source.note: Heading over the two founders' statement in Aprilia Racing's press release on the renewal of the technical partnership for 2026, republished by the Piaggio Group's Wide Magazine.
